text:
jess: Heads up — our samplekit onboarding flow is failing schema validation in JSON mode when auth refresh + retry happens during a streaming tool call. Seen this twice with on-prem test account.
samir: ugh. any logs / repro steps? :thinking_face:
jess: steps: 1) start samplekit -> call /generate with `json_mode: true` and a tool that returns structured chunks 2) force token expiry mid-stream (ctrl+c then reauth in harness) 3) SDK retries the final chunk and we end up with `][` concat in the buffer and validator rejects.
jess: log excerpt:
```
[INFO] stream chunk 6: "\n]\n"
[WARN] retrying request after auth refresh
[INFO] stream chunk 7 (replay): "[\n{\"id\":123...}\n"
[ERROR] schema validator: invalid JSON at position 1
```
maya: whoa — sounds like the SDK is naively concatenating streamed fragments when it should detect replayed prefixes. Is the helper that stitches chunks idempotent?
andre: probably not. current helper does `buffer += chunk` and then `try parse(buffer)` on boundary. If a retry replays a chunk we get `...][...` which is invalid.
samir: two issues here: (A) auth/retry should signal the stream re-start so stitcher can reset, (B) the structured-output helper should tolerate leading/trailing separators (or use framing). I'd prefer framing (length-prefix) for stability.
jess: agreed. short-term patch: strip any leading `]`/`[` fragments when `json_mode: true` before parse. Longer-term: add a stream-session-id header so replays are detected.
maya: can we add a small unit test in sdk-js that simulates: first stream sends "[\n{\"a\":1}\n" then auth-retry replays "[\n{\"b\":2}\n" and assert final assembled body is `[{`
